'''''Becoming One with the Force''''' was a text dealing with the philosophy of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and their relationship with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. It was written by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Trayos Toreggen]].<ref name="TotJC" />
